name: TX-29
label: Safe D

Incumbent Sylvia Garcia running for reelection
Huge fundraising gap: Garcia raised ~$987k vs Fierro's ~$485
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Garcia: a +17 Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, and a lopsided money advantage, with markets pricing her near certain. With no polls or expert ratings available, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin of roughly 24 points.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Garcia that narrows the margin would be the first sign of a real contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
Sylvia Garcia seeks reelection in a Houston-area district that leans Democratic by about 17 points, a strong structural advantage for the incumbent. She has raised nearly $1 million and benefits from over $560,000 in outside support, while Republican challenger Martha Fierro has raised under $500,000 with no reported outside backing. Prediction markets give Garcia roughly a 98% chance of winning.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and market pricing. All of these point the same direction: a comfortable Democratic win, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the outcome.
